name: Freed AI
short_description: Ambient AI scribe that records encounters and generates SOAP notes in 1-2 minutes. Strong for psychiatry medication management; limited for psychotherapy documentation.
long_description: Freed AI is an ambient medical scribe that listens to patient encounters and generates structured clinical notes, primarily in SOAP format. The platform serves 25,000+ clinicians across 30+ specialties with 32 million+ visits transcribed. Freed works by recording in-person or telehealth visits, transcribing the conversation, and producing a note within 1-2 minutes. The Premier tier adds direct EHR push via Chrome extension and ICD-10/CPT coding suggestions. Freed is built for breadth across medical specialties, which makes it useful for psychiatrists who also practice in primary care or other settings. However, Freed was not designed for psychotherapy documentation—it does not understand therapy modalities (CBT, DBT, psychodynamic), cannot generate therapy-specific note formats, and lacks session analytics. Therapists seeking AI documentation should evaluate therapy-specific alternatives like Mentalyc or Upheal.
one_liner: Ambient AI scribe for medical encounters—works for psychiatry med management, not designed for psychotherapy.
best_for: PMHNPs and psychiatric PAs seeing high patient volumes
Multi-specialty clinicians who need one scribe across all settings
Prescribers wanting ICD-10/CPT coding suggestions (Premier tier)
not_for: Therapists doing psychotherapy—Freed does not understand therapy modalities or generate therapy-specific notes
Clinicians needing session analytics or treatment planning features
Practices requiring offline or on-premise transcription
Clinicians who cannot get patient consent for ambient recording

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.description: Up to 40 notes/month. SOAP notes, specialty templates, no coding assistance.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.description: Unlimited notes. Instant template builder, AI editing assistant. No EHR push or coding.

tiers.name: Premier
tiers.description: Unlimited notes + native EHR push + ICD-10 coding suggestions. $104/mo annual, $119/mo monthly.

pricing.notes: No permanent free tier. 7-day free trial, no credit card required. ICD-10 codes require Premier tier. CPT codes in beta on Premier only. Groups pricing available for multi-clinician practices.

compliance.notes: SOC 2 Type II certified. Patient audio is not stored after note generation. BAA provided on all paid plans.

faqs.q: Does Freed AI work for therapists doing psychotherapy?
faqs.a: Freed was not designed for psychotherapy documentation. It generates SOAP notes but does not understand therapy modalities (CBT, DBT, psychodynamic), cannot create therapy-specific note formats, and lacks session analytics. Therapists should evaluate Mentalyc, Upheal, or Berries instead.

faqs.q: How much does Freed AI cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Freed offers three tiers: Starter at $39/month (40 notes), Core at $79/month (unlimited notes), and Premier at $104-119/month (adds EHR push and ICD-10 coding). There is no permanent free tier—only a 7-day trial.
Yes. Freed is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified. Patient audio is not stored after notes are generated. BAA is provided on all paid plans.

faqs.q: Does Freed AI suggest billing codes?
faqs.a: ICD-10 coding suggestions require the Premier tier ($104-119/mo). CPT code suggestions are in beta on Premier only. Starter and Core tiers receive no coding assistance.

faqs.q: What EHRs does Freed integrate with?
faqs.a: Freed integrates via Chrome extension with Epic, Athenahealth, SimplePractice, DrChrono, eClinicalWorks, and others. Direct EHR push (notes auto-populate into charts) requires the Premier tier.
